title: Trump says the UFO issue is being looked into; aliens.gov registered

tellings.quote: this talk of disclosure now and Trump is, you know, Trump and Obama engaged in some sort of bizarre mimetic warfare like a couple months ago and Trump's now saying we're looking into the UFO issue.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2026, after a strange public back-and-forth with former president Barack Obama, US president Donald Trump said his government was 'looking into the UFO issue'. Michels connects this to a wider talk of disclosure, meaning the government publicly admitting what it knows about UFOs. If true, it would mean the question has reached the president's desk.
